verdict.rationale: Canva documents a first-party Apps SDK for building extensions that run inside the Canva editor and add elements or automate tasks. It also has a CLI for creating and managing apps, and apps can be distributed publicly via the Apps Marketplace or privately to a team. The evidence does not mention TypeScript typings or sample apps for the SDK; the OpenAPI description covers the REST/Connect APIs, not editor plugins. Missing for 10: evidence of SDK typings, sample/starter apps, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, a documented plugin API with typings and samples lets me build and distribute my own editor extensions

citations.quote: Use the Canva Apps SDK to bring new design and editing experiences into the Canva editor.
You can use the Apps SDK to create apps that import content into Canva, add elements to a user's design, automate common design tasks, and more.
You can then either distribute the app publicly via the Apps Marketplace, or share it privately with members of your team.
Leverage a command line tool designed for creating and managing Canva apps.
